contracts_rationale: The mission adds no external interface: it changes an internal wording guard, agent prompt and skill text, and one live config key applied through the existing deploy manifest pipeline. Verification is by unit tests and a post-merge canary, not by an interface contract.
purpose_context: Felix's scheduled announce agents (capture, escalation, habits) must deliver only through their final reply. The #1143 fix shipped that rule as prompt doctrine plus a wording guard. Its pre-merge reviews left the guard with false negatives and false positives, a retry rule that can drop a load-bearing helper silently, stale skill wording, and the tools themselves still enabled. This mission closes all six #1146 items so the rule is enforced both in the wording and in the tool policy.
purpose_tldr: Close the delivery-doctrine guard and wording gaps left by #1143, and remove the forbidden send and record tools from Felix's announce agents.
